summary: relief-atlas: manifest-driven humanitarian and civil-protection assets using local Qwen-Image-2.1 and TRELLIS.2 or separate paid cloud backends, offline recovery controls, artifact-bound QA and release accounting, researched prompt recipes, and preserved earlier collections.
